claims.target: Program-length definition and choice of effective machine
claims.proof_section: 4. Délka nejkratšího programu
claims.argument: Use a fixed universal machine whose finite program prints the entire finite word. Different universal languages yield additive simulation overhead; their exact maximizers need not be identical.

claims.target: Maximizers exist separately at every length
claims.proof_section: Délka programu a přesný význam univerzálních testů
claims.argument: There are finitely many words, each has a finite literal-printing description; the maximum exists. It is not a claim about simultaneous maximizing prefixes.

claims.target: Why exact program-complexity maximization is impractical for generation
claims.proof_section: Délka programu a přesný význam univerzálních testů
claims.argument: A total procedure outputting a maximizer at every N would describe it using the fixed procedure and O(log N) bits for N, contradicting max C≥floor(N log2 b).

claims.target: Chaitin independent introduction and historical attribution
claims.proof_section: 4. Délka nejkratšího programu
claims.argument: Only the bibliographic record was obtained; the 1969 full text and historical independence are not newly verified.

claims.target: Expected equidistribution of maximally complex finite words
claims.proof_section: Délka programu a přesný význam univerzálních testů
claims.argument: For any fixed base b, word length k and positive rational deviation, splitting windows into k disjoint classes bounds bad words by b^N exp(−cN). Enumerative coding saves linear bits and excludes maximal complexity for large N.

claims.target: Martin-Löf universal finite tests in their precise conditional scope
claims.proof_section: Délka programu a přesný význam univerzálních testů
claims.argument: Primary 1966 pp602–608: effective tests have nested regions of size≤2^(N−m); index shifts produce a universal test, with |N−C(w|N)−m(w)|≤constant. Per-test level shifts are allowed.

claims.target: Transfer from the book’s unconditional maximization to universal tests
claims.proof_section: Délka programu a přesný význam univerzálních testů

claims.proof_section: 4. Délka nejkratšího programu

claims.proof_section: Zdroje, informace a statistické testy
